collection.title: Citroen Picasso Xsara Picasso 2005 to 2010 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a Citroen Xsara Picasso 2005 to 2010 model which requires a 26" wiper blade on both the drivers side and the passengers side. This model uses the Side Pin arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also have the rear blade for this Xsara Picasso, simply click the Rear Blades tab below.
